# ENV002: Conflicting Node installations or missing target

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: node. Severity: error.

Collector prerequisites: runtimes.

Multiple Node candidates or a selected manager target are inconsistent.

Evidence required: Multiple observed Node candidates, or a missing explicitly selected manager target.

Manual steps:

- Select one Node installation and repair the selected version-manager target.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV002`.

Limitations:

- Multiple candidates are metadata evidence, not proof that an inactive installation is broken.
- nvm/fnm/volta labels come from paths; their commands are never executed.
- Opaque shims and WindowsApps aliases/protected package paths remain unknown. New snapshots with unknown resolution do not support a runtime conflict.

No command is executed by this rule. Evidence comes only from the snapshot. Failed prerequisite collectors disable the rule. Positive, negative and edge fixtures cover Windows, Linux and macOS; platform exclusions are listed above.

Documentation: <https://github.com/shellghostt/envdoctor/blob/main/docs/rules/ENV002.md>.
